source_refs.note: Book p. 25: 'Explanation is given in the figure.' and the four-panel figure (a)-(d). Teaching notes, Exam tip, Key points and Common mistake are ours.

blocks.text: Ab tak hum ne function ko formula aur sets ki madad se pehchana. Lekin aksar exam mein sirf ek graph diya hota hai aur poochha jata hai: "kya yeh function ka graph hai?". Us waqt formula nahin hota. Is ka jawab dene ka ek bohat aasan aur taqatwar tareeqa hai, jise vertical line test kehte hain. Aaj hum yahi seekhenge, aur yeh bhi ke yeh test kaam kyun karta hai.

Kitab kehti hai: vertical line test ek tareeqa hai jis se pata chalta hai ke koi graph function hai ya nahin. Graph function tab aur sirf tab (if and only if) hai jab koi bhi vertical line (khari seedhi line) graph ko ek se zyada dafa na kaate. Agar koi bhi vertical line graph ko ek se zyada dafa kaat de, to woh function nahin.
Kitab kehti hai ke wazahat figure mein di gayi hai. Chaliye figure ko ghor se dekhte hain.

blocks.alt: Four small graphs, each crossed by a vertical line. (a) A wavy curve met by the vertical line at one point: a function. (b) A straight line met at one point: a function. (c) A circle met by the vertical line at two points, one above the other: not a function. (d) An S-shaped curve that doubles back, met by the vertical line at three points: not a function.
blocks.caption: Figure: the vertical line test, (a) a function, (b) a function, (c) not a function, (d) not a function (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Pehle yeh samjhein ke test kaam kyun karta hai, phir ratta lagane ki zaroorat hi nahin rahegi. Vertical line \(x = c\) ke har point ka \(x\)-coordinate ek hi hota hai, yani \(c\). Ab agar yeh line graph ko do points \((c, y_{1})\) aur \((c, y_{2})\) par kaate, jahan \(y_{1} \ne y_{2}\), to iska matlab hai ke ek hi input \(c\) ke do outputs hain. Aur yeh function ki definition ke khilaf hai, jo kehti hai ke har input ka sirf aur sirf ek output ho. Yani vertical line test asal mein definition hi ko graph par check karne ka tareeqa hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ab chaaron graphs ko ek ek kar ke parhte hain:
(a) Curve upar neeche hoti hai, lekin har vertical line ise zyada se zyada ek dafa kaat'ti hai. Is liye yeh function hai. Dhyan dein: graph ka upar neeche jana bilkul jaiz hai.
(b) Tirchhi seedhi line: har vertical line ise bilkul ek dafa kaat'ti hai. Function hai.
(c) Circle (daira): beech se guzarne wali vertical line ise do dafa kaat'ti hai, ek dafa upar wale aadhe hisse par aur ek dafa neeche wale par. Function nahin.
(d) Curve mur kar wapas aati hai; dikhayi gayi vertical line ise teen dafa kaat'ti hai. Function nahin.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ab yahi baat symbols mein dekhte hain. Circle \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 25\) lein. \(x = 3\) rakhein:
\[9 + y^{2} = 25\]
\[y^{2} = 16\]
\[y = 4 \text{ ya } y = -4\]
Yani vertical line \(x = 3\) circle ko \((3, 4)\) aur \((3, -4)\) par kaat'ti hai: input \(3\) ke do outputs. Is liye yahan \(y\), \(x\) ka function nahin.
Lekin agar sirf upar wala aadha hissa lein, \(y = \sqrt{25 - x^{2}}\), to har vertical line use sirf ek dafa kaat'ti hai, kyun ke \(\sqrt{\ }\) sirf positive root deta hai. Yeh aadha circle function hai. Dilchasp baat hai na?

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Neeche diye gaye graphs mein se kaun se function hain?
(a) Seedhi khari line \(x = 2\).
(b) Seedhi leti hui line \(y = 2\).
(c) Parabola \(y = x^{2}\).
Jawab: (a) function nahin: vertical line \(x = 2\) to khud graph ke upar hi lait jati hai aur use beshumar points par chhooti hai; input \(2\) ke beshumar outputs. (b) function hai: har vertical line ise sirf ek dafa kaat'ti hai (har input ka output \(2\)). (c) function hai: parabola upar khulta hai aur har vertical line ise ek hi dafa kaat'ti hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Test lagane ke liye socheiye ke ek khara scale (ruler) graph ke upar baayen se daayen sarka rahe hain. Agar kisi bhi jagah woh graph ko do ya zyada points par chhoo le, to likhein "function nahin" aur woh line bhi batayein, maslan "line \(x = 3\) graph ko do points par kaat'ti hai". Fail karne ke liye ek hi line kaafi hai; pass karne ke liye koi bhi line do dafa na kaate.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Graph function hai agar aur sirf agar koi vertical line use ek se zyada dafa na kaate.
2. Ek vertical line par do points = ek input ke do outputs.
3. Graph upar neeche ja kar bhi function reh sakta hai.
4. Circle aur mur kar wapas aane wali curves \(x\) ke functions ke graph nahin.
5. Vertical line test asal mein function ki definition ko graph par check karna hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Vertical ki bajaye horizontal (leti hui) line istemal kar lena. Agar horizontal line graph ko do dafa kaate to sirf yeh pata chalta hai ke do inputs ka output ek hai, jo function mein jaiz hai. (Horizontal line ka test agle hisse 2.1.4 mein one-to-one ke liye kaam aata hai.)
2. Sirf ek vertical line check kar ke faisla kar dena. Har vertical line ko dekhna hai; ek bhi ghalat line fail kar deti hai.
3. Yeh samajhna ke jo curve upar neeche jaye woh function nahin ho sakti. Upar neeche jana masla nahin; ek hi \(x\) par do points masla hai.
